headline: Nvidia opens a 40-language speech model
dek: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe merges transcription, speakers and translation, per Nvidia.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: One model instead of three
body: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight speech model already on Hugging Face.
Per Nvidia, it transcribes, labels speakers and translates from a single plain-language prompt.

points.t: Transcribes 40 languages, seven of them Indic.
Takes industry terms and formatting rules.
Also answers questions about the audio.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Claimed performance
body: Nvidia says the model ranks first on the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboard and second among open models on Artificial Analysis.
Since the data comes from Nvidia, it is not an independent measurement.

items.t: RTX Spark, DGX Spark and Jetson AGX Thor (Nvidia).

caption.hook: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open speech model that transcribes 40 languages.
body: Per Nvidia, one model transcribes, labels who is speaking and translates, all guided by plain-language prompts. Those steps used to need several chained models.

The company says it leads the Hugging Face Open ASR leaderboard and has 80% fewer active parameters than the top open model, which helps it run on local hardware. Those figures come from Nvidia itself. Quantized builds for RTX Spark and DGX Spark are coming soon.
